brief:
Israeli quadcopter drones have killed at least 60 Palestinian civilians in the Gaza Strip since a ceasefire took effect in October, according to Euro-Med Human Rights Monitor. The rights group documented the deaths among the population in the enclave following the truce agreement.

The killings represent a significant violation of the ceasefire terms, which were intended to halt hostilities between Israeli forces and Palestinian armed groups in Gaza.
dek: Israeli quadcopters killed at least 60 Palestinians since Gaza ceasefire, rights group says Euro-Med Human Rights Monitor said Israeli quadcopter drones have killed at least 60 Palestinian civilians in the Gaza Strip since a ceasefire took effect in October…
title: Israeli drones kill 60 Palestinians since October ceasefire in Gaza
